messages.subject: breedR package install issues
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm trying to install breedR package using these script:
devtools::install_github('famuvie/breedR')

and it comes with these error/warning:
Error: Failed to install 'breedR' from GitHub: Could not find tools necessary to compile a package Call `pkgbuild::check_build_tools(debug = TRUE)` to diagnose the problem.

Anyone can help me for this issues? Thank you

Sincerely,
Fathur

messages.subject: Re: [breedR] breedR package install issues
messages.body_plain:
Dear Fathur,

>From the error message, it seems that you need to install Rtools [1] if you are using R on Windows.

You can also try the installation method from [2]. This is just running the following lines in R:
source("http://famuvie.github.io/breedR/src/setup_repo.R" <http://famuvie.github.io/breedR/src/setup_repo.R>)
install.packages('breedR')

But you probably still need to install Rtools.

Let me know if that works.

Best,

ƒacu.-

[1] https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/

[2] https://famuvie.github.io/breedR/
